headline: Search is growing and security is stronger.
summary: Google clicks rose 25% in October. After a review we updated Next.js, clearing two critical alerts, and fixed 21 site issues.
improvementsNote: Fixes from the October review, finished on 2 November.

improvements.title: Critical security alerts cleared
improvements.body: Next.js and other packages were updated, clearing 2 critical and 8 high alerts.

improvements.title: Easier for every visitor to use
improvements.body: Menu, forms, gallery and slideshows now work with a keyboard and screen readers.

improvements.title: Contact form protected
improvements.body: Repeat sends are now limited, and any failure is reported to us.

improvements.title: Page details corrected
improvements.body: Titles, gallery captions, image descriptions and search data were corrected.

nextMonth: Switch the Google Analytics enquiry tag to the new form event
Strengthen the keyboard focus outline on light sections
Check the home page process images are in the right order
Keep Next.js and other packages on their latest security releases
